lines.trans: Let's go carefully, breathe deeply right now.
Max, do not leave, I am very scared.
He can stay, come on, breathe deeply.
Critical situations test our feelings.
To some they say that the experiment should end.
To others they show that they are on the right path.
And the main discovery still lies ahead.
And our main result is a new life.
Look how beautiful she is.
What will you and I name her?
Did you say we will name her together?
This is our child, thank you, my darling.
